patterns.message: The shared kernel’s domain holds identifiers and event plumbing, and depends on nothing else.
The shared kernel’s application layer holds the ports and faults every context shares, and depends only on the shared kernel.
The platform is technical plumbing shared by every context; it knows no bounded context.
Reach other code through its alias ('@work/…', '@platform/…'): '@/…' and relative parent paths bypass every boundary rule.
The application root composes the context modules: it imports their module classes and their startup hooks, and nothing else.
Reach other code through its alias ('@work/…', '@platform/…'): '@/…' and relative parent paths bypass every boundary rule.
